title: V3.4 Intervention Evidence Schema
description: Schema for physical and observable evidence supporting the assertion of an active safety intervention, distinguishing proximity from intervention.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this physical evidence record.

event_id.description: Identifier of the associated safety candidate or event.

evidence_type.description: Specific physical modality of the safety intervention.

description.description: Detailed description of the observed physical intervention behavior.

observation_channel.description: Physical sensor channel from which evidence was derived.

telemetry_support_status.description: Whether objective vehicle/controller bus telemetry exists to verify the maneuver.

evidence_confidence.description: Confidence level in the validity of the intervention observation.

deceleration_magnitude_mps2.description: Measured or estimated deceleration rate, if available.

steering_angle_deflection_deg.description: Measured or estimated angular heading deflection, if available.
